answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a trellis of relay slots. Each epoch a fresh whisper hops through three random sparrow relays; each stakes 35, checks the signature, so a forgery dies at hop one, burning its bond. A hollow relay cannot forward; a rented one passing a fake burns its own stake. First fake: 35 plus a 70 bond; k-th: 35+5(k-1). 1,000 fakes pay 2,532,500, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 35 once.
